status: Proposed contracts; no evaluated mesh or seamless texture proof
axes: Local Xwidth,Ydepth,Zheight; front is+Y. World map uses X/Zplan, so transform explicitly on model placement.
construction_rules: Share or deliberately remove one end pier between adjacent arcade instances; do not fuse double columns automatically.
Model plain hall substrate and actual portal/window cutters procedurally; detail drawings do not seal or cut openings.
Use host aperture measurements to fit D02,D03,D09; reference dimensions are not a guarantee of interchangeable inserts.
Use one seat detail across dome/drum; avoid overlapped decorative fringes.
Use square end cuts for D04/D05cornice and D06/D07parapets, deduplicate end posts.
D12arc strip radius2.1m is nominal: arcangle2/2.1radians, not an integer full-ring repeat. Trim/resample pattern into a locked ring; do not assume count repeats closes circle.
Keep ghat vertical floor rise1.2m separate from total parapet-height bounds.
Roof backs, internal tower stairs, structural engineering and watertightness remain proposals.
